beneficiaryOrPayeeName.description: Beneficiary or payee name exactly as printed on the slip. If not visible, use not_shown.

payerOrRemitterName.description: Payer, remitter, or debited account name if shown. If not visible, use not_shown.

amountAsPrinted.description: Monetary amount exactly as printed (keep commas, decimals, and currency symbol if present).

currency.description: Currency as shown, e.g. HKD, USD, or symbol. If unclear, use not_shown.

documentOrReferenceId.description: Primary reference: document number, DN code, transaction ref, or similar. If none, not_shown.

transactionNature.description: Type of transaction, e.g. TRANSFER, FPS, remittance. If not labeled, not_shown.

valueDateOrPostingDate.description: Value date, posting date, or transaction date as printed (any format). If absent, not_shown.

institutionName.description: Bank, wallet, or platform name/logo text if identifiable. Else not_shown.

oneLineSummary.description: One concise English sentence summarizing what the receipt proves or shows.
